items.title: Arch Linux / Hyprland Dotfiles Setup
items.desc: Быстрая инициализация окружения Hyprland, Waybar и SwayNC.
items.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Quick Setup Script for Hyprland
sudo pacman -S --noconfirm hyprland waybar swaync kitty rofi-wayland
mkdir -p ~/.config/hypr
curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/user/dots/main/hyprland.conf > ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf
echo 'Done! Launching Hyprland...'
